aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Skandamātā; your name comes fifth (among the nine Durgās). You know what is in every heart; you are the Mother of the world, the mother of all. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: May I keep your flame burning; may I meditate on you always. You have been called by many names; I have one support, yours. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: In some places your dwelling is on the mountains; in many cities you make your home. In every temple there are sights of you; your beloved devotees sing your virtues. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Grant me devotion to you; O Śakti, set right what has gone wrong for me. Indra and all the other gods together make their plea at your door. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: When the wicked demons came marching on, you alone raised the sword in your hand. You came to save your servants always; you came to fulfil your devotee's hope. ॥5॥
